title: check.py refuses a source row that pins this repository's own blob at a commit the public home does not hold
goal: BG-wl36adcq's worker wrote a source row for kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv as a github.com blob pinned at eb079a248457, an integration-remote hash that kbgit.py publish rewrites, so the url would 404 on the public home; the orchestrator caught it by hand and the row now pins the projection's e2b6ca068. A source row whose url is a blob of this repository on its public home names a commit on the public main (or the check says it cannot read that remote), and kb/_self names how such a self-sourced row is pinned (found by the SP-gcerxjsg retrospective).

run:
import re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
src = Path(".").resolve()
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
shutil.copytree(src / "_tools", tmp / "_tools", ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc"))
root = tmp / "kb" / "public"
root.mkdir(parents=True)
(root / "_root.md").write_text("---\nroot: public\nid_prefix: S\nvisibility: public\ndescription: t\n---\n\n# public\n")
head = "id,url,title,publisher,licence,reuse,retrieved_utc,version_or_date,artifact_sha256,used_in,superseded_by\n"
url = "https://github.com/example/it-ops-kb/blob/eb079a248457aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv"
(root / "_sources.csv").write_text(head + "S100," + url + ",bench,Example,MIT,copy,2026-10-10,eb079a248457,,,\n")
(root / "_artifacts.csv").write_text("source_id,path,sha256,bytes,retrieved_utc\n")
def run(*a):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=40)
run("git", "init", "-q")
run("git", "remote", "add", "pub", "git@github.com:example/it-ops-kb.git")
run("git", "config", "kb.publishRemote", "pub")
p = run(sys.executable, "_tools/check.py")
mine = [l for l in (p.stdout + p.stderr).splitlines() if "S100" in l or "eb079a248457" in l]
assert any(re.search(r"public|remote|origin/main", l, re.I) for l in mine), "check.py says nothing of a source row pinning this repository blob on its public home: " + str(mine)
